english.title: Prohibited vehicle in offside lane of motorway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[drove]_
(B)_[moved]_
(C)_[stopped]_
(D)_[caused to remain at rest]_

(E)_[a goods vehicle which had a maximum laden weight exceeding 7.5 tonnes,]_
(F)_[a goods vehicle which had a maximum laden weight exceeding 3.5 tonnes but not exceeding 7.5 tonnes, and to which regulation 36B of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 applied,]_
(G)_[a motor tractor,]_
(H)_[a light locomotive,]_
(I)_[a heavy locomotive,]_
(J)_[a motor vehicle drawing a trailer]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on the right hand or offside lane of a length of carriageway of the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..) which had three or more traffic lanes open for use by traffic proceeding in the same direction
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 12(2) of the Motorways Traffic (England and Wales) Regulations 1982, section 17(4) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drove / moved / stopped / caused to remain at rest
a goods vehicle OR
motor tractor OR
light locomotive OR
heavy locomotive OR
motor vehicle and trailer OR
goods vehicle to which a speed limiter is fitted
in the offside / right hand lane
of three traffic lanes length
of a carriageway of motorway
whilst all lanes were open and traffic proceeding in same direction

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 12(3) and (4) for exceptions.
(ii) See regulation 12(5) for meaning of 'goods vehicle' and 'maximum laden weight'.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) Fixed penalty ticket scheme may be applied
(v) This regulation applies to ALL goods vehicles the gross vehicle weight of which exceeds 3500kg.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant

(A)_[drove]_
(B)_[moved]_
(C)_[stopped]_
(D)_[caused to remain at rest]_

**(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on the offside lane of the **(..SPECIFY NORTH, SOUTH, EAST OR WEST..) bound carriageway of the **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..).

All the lanes of the carriageway were open for use by traffic proceeding in that direction.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
